about: I am a full-stack developer in Quebec focused on systems that survive real production use: clear boundaries, typed data, visible proof, and maintainable delivery paths.

My day-to-day work sits at the intersection of .NET/C#, React, SQL, authentication, integrations, background processing, and CI/CD. I like the parts where product constraints, data quality, and engineering reliability meet.

Recently, I have been exploring practical agentic and LLM-powered workflows inside business applications: not AI theater, but tools that reduce manual work, surface better decisions, and fit existing operations.
I care about code reviews, planning, debugging, performance, and the unglamorous details that make a release trustworthy.

experienceSummary.title: Production full-stack work, 4+ years
bullets: Built and maintained .NET + React applications used in operational environments.

Improved SQL, EF Core, LINQ, and routing/geolocation workloads, including reductions above 80% on targeted processing paths.
